placements.overview: Founded in 1989, Institute of Media, Management, Technology & Agro Sciences is an institute. It is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Institute of Media, Management, Technology & Agro Sciences provides UG and PG courses in Full Time mode. It provides 15 courses across specialisations such as Agriculture, Finance, Human Resources and International Business. Some of the courses offered at this institute include MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., BCA, B.Com and B.A. Institute of Media, Management, Technology & Agro Sciences fees ranges between INR 56,000 to 2,35,000. Institute of Media, Management, Technology & Agro Sciences offers these course across fields such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce, Mass Communication & Media, Humanities & Social Sciences and Hospitality & Travel. Institute of Media, Management, Technology & Agro Sciences offers all the campus facilities to students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: About our education at Newton's College.

content.Placements: In our college, most students are placed in companies like Tata, Tesla, and HCL. Our college offers various courses across all departments, including MBA, MCA, BBA, and B.Com. Internships are provided through programs like Google STEP for second-year students. Roles offered in the college include Java development, which is a complete course for senior students. content.Infrastructure: Mainly in our college, the infrastructure is very poor. In the ECE branch, there are only a limited number of classrooms. There is no Wi-Fi facility on campus, not even in the library, and the library also lacks air conditioning. In the bookstall, many books are missing. Sports and games facilities are limited, and no tournaments are conducted in the college. The canteen has no fans, and there are very few benches available.

In the library, there is no AC and only fans and lights are available. The library infrastructure is too bad in this college. The quality of the food is the worst.
content.Faculty: Teachers here mainly our HOD Sunithamam the kind of the heart and she teaches the maths subject. The teaching faculty members speaking is needed to be improved in this college. reviews.review_text: Mainly in our college, the infrastructure is very poor. In the ECE branch, there are only a limited number of classrooms. reviews.review_heading: Whatever it may be, I like the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good in terms of students' perspective.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college with decent facilities.

individual_reviews.title: Very much satisfied with the faculty and the environment.

content.Placements: They will be conducting placements for final-year students. Mostly only BPO companies will hire during placements. individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Budget friendly and great college experience.

content.Placements: My college was very poor at placing students through campus interviews. Before COVID, companies used to show more interest in hiring students during campus placements, but after COVID, they reduced their interest in hiring from our college. As a result, I didn’t get any campus opportunities from my college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure that was provided by the college was pretty good and clean. There were computer labs, seminar halls, a party area, and free Wi-Fi provided by the college. The hostel facilities were good to decent. The food offered in the mess was satisfactory. It tasted good, and they particularly followed the weekly menu, providing non-veg twice a week. Moreover, the whole campus was surrounded by greenery, which refreshed my mind and gave me a lot of peace.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A college with great infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Noble Institute of Science and Technology College is very good for studying the MCA course. Around 70% of students get placed in the course. The highest salary offered is Rs. 2,00,000 per month. Almost 84% of students got internships from this course.
content.Infrastructure: Noble Institute of Science and Technology College provides better quality infrastructure and facilities. We have good Wi-Fi connectivity and classrooms. The hostel facilities are very good. The canteen and medical facilities need to be developed.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure. Experienced faculty, but they are unstable in the college.

content.Placements: We got placements more for marketing related such as a cease-fire, Kotak Mahindra, Genpact, shoppers stop, etc. For finance, we got BNP Paribas bank, Genpact, Cognizant, and some minor companies as well. reviews.review_heading: Budget friendly and great college experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure that was provided by the college was pretty good and clean. There were computer labs, seminar halls, a party area, and free Wi-Fi provided by the college. The hostel facilities were good to decent. The food offered in the mess was satisfactory. It tasted good, and they particularly followed the weekly menu, providing non-veg twice a week. Moreover, the whole campus was surrounded by greenery, which refreshed my mind and gave me a lot of peace.

reviews.review_heading: A college with great infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Noble Institute of Science and Technology College provides better quality infrastructure and facilities. We have good Wi-Fi connectivity and classrooms. The hostel facilities are very good. The canteen and medical facilities need to be developed.

reviews.review_heading: Better infrastructure facilities and quality of teaching.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure facilities are available in this college, including classrooms, computer labs, and libraries, as well as better mess and hostel facilities. Medical and sports facilities are also good. The college environment is very good and peaceful for the students.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good. You must gain the minimum knowledge in this college.
reviews.review_text: This college has big classrooms and good AC labs. A good library which is separated for MBA and MCA. The students participate in events and sports. From two years, the college students participate in Eenadu cricket tournament. The quality of the food available in the canteen is good. Very good hostel, and very good playground.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure. Experienced faculty, but they are unstable in the college.
reviews.review_text: We have a library, canteen, computer lab, seminar halls, parking spaces, and beautiful campus with greenery in our college. Our college can accomodate many as we have nearly two buildings. It also has a hostel facility. The college buses are also available. It is a Wi-Fi enabled campus. In two seminar halls, more than 200 people can accomodate.

reviews.review_heading: Iam satisfied with NIST college
reviews.review_text:
Good infrastructure and good facilities in the campus, library, labs, hostel facilities . Good food is available. 
Lab facilities are also available after college hours. 10 systems are exclusively for hostelliers . Advanced technologies we have learnt.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Noble Institute of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: College facilities provided were average. Wi-Fi was not working, but the library was good. Classrooms were average, and the teaching was also good. The syllabus was completed on time. Bus facility was not provided. Students are given RTC passes. Washrooms were not good, and improvement was needed.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average. But the management is pakka commercial. They think only about business. They don't care about students. All they want is fees. Poor management. No Wi-Fi. Food is above average. No sports no games. Only fees collected. Really fed up those 2 years. Only positive things are, hostel is of low fees and food is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for engineering.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a good library, and a Wi-Fi campus. The hostel facilities are clean and comfortable. Mess and canteen food are decent. Basic medical care, sports grounds, and indoor games are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are available in Puran Murti campus and very good infrastructure is available for my course. Best computer labs for coding. Best computers with good processing speed. All books are available in the library. Good facilities are available in the hostel. Daily new variety of food is available. I like that.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best college in Delhi NCR.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities and infrastructure are available for all the courses and departments. Well-quality and fully airy labs are well managed, and healthy food is available in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities, sports and games, and good facilities for the hostel are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: I like my college a lot, and I assume that others will like it too, as it's a worthwhile college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is to my liking as it has lots of greenery, a few big grounds, and many smaller ones. Although I didn't opt for a hostel, when I visited my friend, I noticed that the hostel was Wi-Fi equipped. Rooms were clean, and bathrooms were good. The food was to my liking, too.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Sonipat for programming students.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a green environment, great classrooms and the best library. There is no air pollution as the area is full of greenery without any noise pollution. Well-furnished hostels and best quality foods are available. Medical facilities are available in case of an emergency. Food is also provided by the college. For cricket, there is the best ground and an auditorium is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure, staff, and teachers are really good.
reviews.review_text: I mostly love the infrastructure of my campus. There are smart classes available on campus, proper lighting, false ceilings, proper windows, airy and big rooms are available. Wi-Fi is also available on all floors and offices. All types of books are available in the library. The food in my canteen is very hygienic and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Education at best- Puran Murti campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. All the labs are well-maintained. They have hangers for three aircraft to be placed. The environment is very good here. This campus is recommended for all students for different courses like B.Tech. Management and pharmacy.

reviews.review_heading: Puran Murti Campus is a Home-like College Where Students Meet Their Expectations.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are extraordinary. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The labs are equipped with all necessary equipment in all labs, including ECE, EE, Mechanical, Aviation, and CSE. The library includes all books, including the latest editions, and has subscriptions to all journals.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with infrastructure and faculty of my college.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is equipped with all facilities like Wi-Fi, classrooms, a moot court, and a spacious library. College has a lush green playground with cricket, football, basketball courts, etc. Hostel food is excellent. Medical facilities and doctors are available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Puran Murti Campus.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available always. Classrooms are also fine and library too. I am not in the hostel but some of my friends told me that hostel facilities are good. Food quality is also good. The canteen of the college is very bad. For sports, there is a very big ground for playing cricket, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in my knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The Wi-Fi facility is good. Labs are very good with all the instruments. The library has enough books and reference books. Our college provides very good classrooms. The quality of the food served in a mess is average. The college organises sports events from time to time for entertainment as well as for fitness purposes.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good and has good placements.
reviews.review_text: It is a lovely college with a lovely ground. There are various facilities provided in this college, and there are various types of labs like computer labs, pharmacy labs, mechanical labs, civil labs, etc. A canteen is also available.

reviews.review_heading: In my opinion my PM College Of Engineering is good.
reviews.review_text: PM College of Engineering, gives a good infrastructure of a class programme, the class is well-maintained, the college has good Wi-Fi speed connection, it is free for all students, the college maintains good sports facility, you can play a various game here. The medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very bad. Both money and life are wasted here.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility is available, but there is no internet connection in it. The classrooms are very good. The labs are available, but there are no proper instruments in it. There are no medical facilities. Government schools mid-day meal is better than the canteen. The hostel rooms are in very poor condition. The facilities are illiterate.

reviews.review_heading: At the end the college is quite satisfying apart from faculty dissatisfaction.
reviews.review_text:
One of the best thing about college is infrastructure. It spreads in 60 acres of land. Wi-Fi facility is available all over the campus. Labs are available for all subjects. There is a large ground for games and other activities
There is a first aid room in college where a doctor is always present to lookout for students.

APS College of Engineering Karnataka PGCET cutoff 2025 was concluded with the release of the final cutoff list. For admission to the MBA/PGDM course, the last round cutoff rank was 27936 in the General AI category.

Karnataka PGCET is the accepting exam for MBA/PGDM admission at APS College of Engineering. In 2025, the last round cutoff for MBA/PGDM admission was 27936 in the General category under the AI quota. In 2024, the cutoff rank for the same course was 35949.
For more categories, rounds, and quotas, candidates can use the provided filters to view the cutoffs.
Candidates preparing for 2026 admission can refer to the table below to view some of the important dates related to Karnataka PGCET 2026.

APS College of Engineering accepts Karnataka PGCET entrance exam scores for admission to the MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the table below to check out the consolidated year-wise Karnataka PGCET cutoff lists.

As per the KCET last-round cutoff 2025 for B.E. / B.Tech admission, B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) has the lowest cutoff rank of 90885 for the General AI quota. The lower cutoff rank indicates strong competition for admission.
In 2024, the last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 63389, in the General All India quota.

According to the APS College of Engineering B.E. / B.Tech Cutoff 2025, the closing rank for B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering stood at 41643 among the students belonging to the General AI quota.
Students can use the filters provided below to view the cutoff for other categories and quotas for 2025, 2024 and 2023.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are very good. It has a good Wi-Fi. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is good. The food available in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities, sports, games, and everything are great. It has a good library management.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good teachers.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are great in this college. Playground is available for sports like cricket. It also has volleyball and basketball courts. Indoor activities are also conducted, such as carrom, table tennis, chess, etc. Many types of equipment are well-organised. The food served in the mess is decent.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with placements and campus.
reviews.review_text: This campus is great and vast. It has a good study atmosphere. It is peaceful. There is a separate safe and secure hostel for girls. The girls' hostel is on campus. The boys' hostel is a bit far from campus. Bus facilities are provided for conveyance during a break. The infrastructure of our department is vast. It is well-maintained by faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for CSE and ISE but not good for mechanical, civil, and ECE.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are good. Our college provides good infrastructure. Our classrooms are well-built. Labs are good.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The canteen food is good and medical facilities also. Facilities available in our college are hygiene. Sports facilities are good. The library is very silent and it is the best place to read. Labs are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college teachers are good.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good with well-equipped labs and dedicated internet for students. Hostel is also good and provides good meals. We have both boys and girls hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of APS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are good in the girls' hostel, and even the girls' hostel warden is good. There is no Wi-Fi connection. A library and an internet room are available. The department is good, and the classrooms are big and spacious. Medical facilities are available. They encourage students in sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of APS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is a bit okay, but the hostel is not at all good. The food is the worst. Facilities are bad. The library is good. The classrooms are good. Labs are good to conduct all the experiments. I don't know about medical facilities. They encourage us in sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of APS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: APS College of Engineering has a useful library, which contains 20,000 books. There are a physics laboratory, chemistry laboratory and internet laboratory. There are huge classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: APS college of engineering is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: Divya city shopping college and hostel are very good this college consists of large classroom, many laboratory libraries college has eco friendly environment the quality of Fortis record canteen and hostels college has medical facilities in case emergency and students who have participated in sports and represent for VTU.

reviews.review_heading: Our college campus is good.
reviews.review_text: The food provided is good, and Wi-Fi facilities are also available. Rooms are clean.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college. I like it.
reviews.review_text: Nice food will be provided. There will be Wi-Fi facilities. The rooms are clean.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not provide huge classrooms. The staff room is huge, but there are no faculty members. The campus is huge, but there is no security. The admin office is huge. The canteen is beautiful, but it does no serve food for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is satisfactory for the amount you pay.
reviews.review_text: The college has transport facilities, but you have to pay an additional fee for that. As far as infrastructure is concerned, there are few buildings, and even most of them are old. Labs are fine, and even the instructors are friendly and helpful. There are Wi-Fi facilities, but the connection is poor. Only the computer lab has a good Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of faculty members, campus and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities provided by the college are good. The campus is well-maintained and has a good environment with trees, plants and gardens. The playground, library, classrooms and staff members are good.

individual_reviews.course: MBA + PGPM Certification - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Great scholarships are there.

content.Placements: The placement is overall good. Deepshikha has good placements for every student. It offers good placements for every student. The highest package is 10 lakhs per annum. I was impressed by the track record of placement at our college. Many well-known companies visit Deepshikha campuses for student placement. The placement cell is also there at our campus, which helps students prepare for placement.
content.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure facilities are provided to students talking about the library and classroom quality of facility is being provided. The campus's infrastructure is commendable. As a campus student, it is fairly relevant how we get to enjoy every campus event and how college work is carried out quite easily.

individual_reviews.course: MBA + PGPM Certification - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Placements good. Almost each and every student got placed.

content.Placements: In Deepshikha, almost 95% of students graduated from college. Every student got placed in top companies. Our college is the best in terms of placement, as it gives full attention and focuses on every student. Top companies also visited my college for placement.
content.Infrastructure: Deepshikha is equipped with smart classrooms. The library has more than 50,000 books and also provides access to the PDF version. Campus cleanliness is good, and they keep an eye on everyone, and the people take care of it. The college provides indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: MBA + PGPM Certification - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The college campus is good. You will feel satisfied with the college services.

content.Placements: It is a very good college for placements. Around 95% of students get placed every year. You have good grades and good knowledge. You will feel satisfied with the college. Every student will get an internship at the end. Many organizations pick up students from my college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is huge and well-maintained. Everything is perfect. Hostel is also good. I enjoyed being here, and most of the people here are good. You will feel satisfied with the college services. The campus environment is fully safe and secure. Canteens are also good.

individual_reviews.course: MBA + PGPM Certification - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for placement and practical exposure.

content.Placements: Almost 99% of students are placed. Our college authorities and the placement cell were helpful. Most importantly, every student has 3 to 4 companies. The highest salary package offered was 11 LPA, and the lowest was 5.65 LPA. According to money, one of the best colleges provides good part-time internships.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are air-conditioned and well-furnished. The library has a lot of books, and we have a digital library. The auditorium was amazing and also had indoor game facilities. We have an audio-video room; this is one of the best interview practice rooms.

individual_reviews.course: MBA + PGPM Certification - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The environment of our campus is too good.

content.Placements: Placement almost 98% of students got placed in our college . Top companies Amul , Reliance , AU smal finance , Anz Bank , Pwk, Berkaida etc Top roles offer are Assi Managers , sales executive , analyst and credit appraiser . the highest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The Average salary package offered is 6 LPA . Most important thing is that they offered Paid internship after going the course of MBA PGPM .
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a lush green campus .A huge library is available in our campus ,it has many books the infrastructure is good Which is require in a classroom .our classroom as equipped with air- conditioners with excellent quality of projector screen .

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I suggest you choose another college rather than this one.

content.Placements: None of the students from our course got placed. Companies do not visit our college for placements. None of the students from our course got an internship at the college. Roles like developer, trainee, etc., are offered in our course. It was not a good college.
content.Infrastructure: It has poor infrastructure. There are no proper Wi-Fi labs. Classrooms are too small, and they are half repaired. Our college does not provide a hostel facility. The college construction was a half-baked type. The college stopped construction in between, and it is left like that. Classrooms are not much good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: College is very peaceful environment for study but placement facility should improve.

content.Placements: Around 20 per cent of students got placed in this course. The highest package offered for this course is 6 lakhs per annum, the lowest package for this course is 4 lakhs per annum and the average package is 5 lakhs per annum. Recruiting companies like Hcl, Toshiba transformation and distribution are there. Computer science and engineering, electrical and electronics engineering and electronics and communication engineering are the best course offered in this college.
content.Infrastructure: Almost every facility is available and infrastructure is very good like free Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi labs and classrooms are well maintained. Medical facilities are there because for TRR medical college. Besides our engineering college, canteen and sports games are maintained and efficient.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The college is only good for electrical students, and does not have any extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: There are no placements provided in our college. The placement percentage of our seniors was zero. The average salary offered was Rs. 8,000 per month and the highest was Rs. 50,000 per month. Not even one company visited the college till now. There are internships provided, but there is no use of those internships as they don't provide any employment in future, and there is no stipend too.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available, and the labs are not good. The library is good, but there are no medical facilities provided. I faced many issues in college every day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Best college from my bottom of heart. I would suggest all to join in this college.

By participating a co-curricular and extra curricular activities you will be buliding you resume. Companies would always choose people who have worked in a team or make different project or the one who like to compete. These are few skill that a company looking for in a new employee. I would suggest to all do best in all activities amd and studies.
content.Infrastructure: When it became about college infrastructure the college was accredited 'Best infrastructure of the year' everyone should like the college and it is best infrastructure. The facilities like Wi-Fi, games, classes, labs, sports all are good. The food quality is also very good and tasty. You will not any problem related to the infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: The worst college with worthless staff.

content.Placements: There are no placements here. Not even BPOs come here as this is just a college to get the bachelor's degree. The only preference that lecturers give here is based on caste or to rich people. They respect them and also award them full marks in their internals. There will be no placement assistant or at least campus training here.
content.Infrastructure: The college atmosphere is very good. One can enjoy the nature around the college. The cons of this college are as follows, there is no Wi-Fi for the students, but every department has its own Wi-Fi, only for the faculty members and their favourite students. Also, the labs here are just showcased with worthless equipment. The classrooms here are well-spacious.

review_summary.college_name: Sri Sivani College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The faculty are well-mannered and skilled. Good placement in 4 years till now, 2025 on campus.

content.Placements: AI and ML are my courses, and I'm an AI student. I proudly say that 90% of students choose this course. In this course, there are a lot of high-paying opportunities. The AI meets its necessary needs in the present situation. The top companies are Infosys, Capgemini, Google, etc. 90% of the work is with AI only. Maximum 70% of students get internships, with top roles like machine learning engineer, data analytics, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Sri Sivani College of Engineering has good infrastructure, ground, and garden with clean and peaceful surroundings. The labs are well-mannered with proper systems and equipment, not only for computer labs, but other department labs are available with proper facilities. There is the biggest library compared to the surrounding colleges. The hostel has proper rooms and facilities, and peaceful rooms to visit again for the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I was average compared to other colleges in my location.

content.Placements: The college is not so good, I wasn't much satisfied with my college placements. They are not bringing any top multi national companies and not giving any on campus job opportunities to the students. For the internship also, we should search about it through online portals.
content.Infrastructure: As I was not a hostler but my friends in the hostel are telling the food was not so good and the rooms are also uncomfortable sometimes. They are not providing any Wi-Fi facility to the students for the browsing of any other educational websites.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: They should also improve the hostel facilities to get students attracted.

content.Placements: Only 10 per cent of our students are getting placed and there will be no on-campus placements in the college. We have to prepare ourselves to get placed we have to apply for the off-campus placements where we can get a chance but it's hard to get a placement.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good and the faculty is not bad but not much high level. There is a library where we can find every book related to that branch. The hostel was not good as my friends told me the food was not quite good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Placements are good in our college. Many students got placed from our college in companies like TCS, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Our college has a good environment. All facilities are very good. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Our classrooms are very neat. Labs are good. The hostel is very good.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They always help us in our studies. They always clear our doubts. Semester exams are very difficult but our teachers prepare us to attempt well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for middle-class students.

content.Placements: There were 5 branches. Every branch provides 60 seats and for CSE and mechanical students had two sections, those students were around 120 each. Mostly students take the course very interesting and serious. Many students got internships in HMI Engineering Services Visakhapatnam, and that institute give a lot of knowledge to develop final year project and to crack a job in IT.
content.Infrastructure: This is a good college and provides sufficient infrastructure. The library, classrooms, and sports room were available. It provides good hostel and provides the proper diet in the food. The food was good, taste, and healthy. The canteen was also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is an affordable college.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA. The average salary package offered is 3.5 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 2. The top recruiting company is Sonalika.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The library contains a large stock of books, but books are old, and the majority of topics are available in those books. After the covid, the hostel is still closed.
content.Faculty: Teachers are good and hardworking. The mechanical industry is the base of developing and developed countries. Exams are average, but teachers conduct exams very seriously.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Our college has tie-ups with Microsoft, a Canadian university, and companies like Tech Mahindra. Drives are held monthly by various well-known companies, and students take part in them.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are airy. Free Wi-Fi is provided to students. Labs are well managed. There are different smart rooms for personality development classes. There are labs in every block of the college. Hostels have been closed since COVID time and are yet to be reopened.
content.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified. Their teaching methods are good, especially in maths. The coding teacher doesn't know how to teach. The course is regularly updated according to industrial needs. Exams are tough but not very hard to pass.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the college. One should take admission in a government college.

content.Placements: No single student got placed through college placements, but by off-campus, everyone got placed in reputed companies, like L&T, Punj Lloyd, Unitech, etc. No students got an internship through college, but from their resources, everyone got an internship in companies like L&T, DLF, Punj Lloyd, Soma, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There was no Wi-Fi facility from 2006-2010, but now I don't know. There are good labs, classrooms and also a library in the college. The college hostel is average as per the price they charge. The breakfast provided in the hostel is good, but dinner used to be pathetic. Sometimes I used to eat chapati with sugar to get sleep. There are no medical facilities in the college. There are good sports and games at the college. There is a vast stadium in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: I had a very bad experience in the college.

content.Placements: There were no placements for my branch. The college doesn't provide placements to the students who don't have proper knowledge about their subjects.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college was very bad. Classrooms were in very poor condition and were not maintained properly. Washrooms were not even usable. Wi-Fi facility was available just for namesake. The library was not maintained properly. The canteen was not much good. Drinking water facilities were sometimes not available on the campus, and you have to go to some other place to have water. Overall, the infrastructure of the college was very poor.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Yes its getting success in placement and infrastructure year by year.

content.Placements: I got no placement from college. But in my training of 6 month I got placed in Bangalore in techasoft Pvt. Lmt company. Currently working in Indore in simpalm company. I am a Android developer. And working on live application in my company. From my college I did not get any support but from my faculty I got lots of support they helped what I should do to be successful in my life.
content.Infrastructure: There is separate block for each category students and each block has least 3 or 4. Floors and each floors has around 5 to 7 classrooms. College has lots of open places like park, play ground, parking place, at the break time we used parks for having sun Ray's in winter's and used tree in summer season. There physical time at that time we play different games in playground. Gym also there to trained our students for games. For national level.
